answer_1.quote: We propose a novel LLM-generated data framework ... ChemActor, a.k.a. ChemActor, as a chemical executor to convert unstructured human-readable descriptions to structured machine-executable actions.
answer_1.outputs: Structured procedural action sequences (e.g., ADD, STIR, WASH) derived from experimental description texts

answer_2.quote: We assess performance using the Sequence Matching (SM) and ExactMatch (EM) metrics ... We also introduce BERTScore and LLMs circle review for further evaluation.

answer_3.quote: We design an LLMs circle review metric ... employing four LLMs (GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4, LLaMA-3, and Mistral) to independently assess prediction‑annotation semantic similarity.

answer_4.quote: We invite six Ph.D. and M.S. students from the department of chemistry to assess the prediction results on the CHEMTRANS test set. Each prediction is required to be scored on a scale from 0 to 10.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assign a score from 0 to 10 for each generated action sequence.
